assumptions.choice: Evaluated bandwidth and 100-day min/max range on bar t-1 (previous completed close)
assumptions.reason: At market open of day t, bar t close price is not yet available; using completed bar t-1 prevents lookahead bias.

assumptions.choice: Enabled cheat-on-open and cheat-on-close on the broker to permit buy order execution at Open_t and exit at Close_t
assumptions.reason: The specification explicitly requires entering long at Open_t based on Open_t gap and exiting at Close_t on the same day.

assumptions.choice: Calculated Proxy IV Rank as (BW - Min_100) / (Max_100 - Min_100) and checked for <= 0.20
assumptions.reason: Direct mathematical implementation of proxy IV Rank <= 20% on the 100-day range of Bollinger Bandwidth.

assumptions.choice: Used default sizer via self.buy() without explicit size parameter
assumptions.reason: Specification dictates fixed stake (substitute for 2 contracts) without giving an explicit share quantity, triggering Canonical Default 1.
